claims: Floor division never overcounts and its remainder is strictly below the positive divisor.
A single CPMM-style floor-division hop has raw numerator rounding residue below the denominator.
Any abstract multi-hop rounding-gap sequence with base gap at most 1 and per-step increase at most C has gap at most C*k-(C-1).
The conservative route model specializes the general theorem to a 2*k-1 accumulated rounding bound.
The Lipschitz route model specializes the general theorem to a k accumulated rounding bound.
The Lipschitz bound is always no worse than the conservative bound and is strictly better when k >= 2.
The general, conservative, and Lipschitz bounds have explicit tightness witnesses.
proof_method: integer recurrence induction over hop count
specialization of the parameterized recurrence theorem
explicit witness functions for tightness and non-vacuity

boundaries: The main multi-hop theorems are abstract recurrence bounds; a concrete runtime route must still prove its gap function satisfies the stated base and step hypotheses.
The single-hop CPMM theorem bounds floor-division residue in numerator units, not complete economic route optimality.
These proofs do not by themselves prove reserve updates, authorization, oracle freshness, or route canonicality.
